quarterly_data.signal: 2Q 2026 earnings deck (consolidated, KRW 100 million): Q2 revenue +9.0% YoY and operating profit 273 (+16.0% YoY, OPM 15.2%). Q2 revenue by industry: semiconductor 1,147 (Q2 2025: 1,059), display 627 (559), other 16 (24); 1Q26: semiconductor 1,083, display 615. H1 consolidated revenue +8.7% and operating profit +16.0% YoY; separate-basis H1 revenue +12.4% and operating profit +2.6%. Revenue mix: semiconductor 64%, display 36%. The company attributes growth to higher supply of process materials as next-generation memory production expands on AI-infrastructure investment (semiconductor) and to premium OLED expansion and customers' competitiveness (display), and says profitability improved through production efficiency and cost competitiveness despite higher raw-material prices and fixed costs, with newly consolidated subsidiaries broadening the portfolio and stabilising the supply chain. Sites: Kyle (US) plant makes semiconductor process chemicals, Guangzhou (China) makes display etchants, subsidiary UB Materials makes CMP slurry and subsidiary PAM Technology makes hydrofluoric-acid-related process chemicals.
